purpose: Define the highest-fidelity public-evidence exam simulation without importing or reproducing live, recalled, screenshot-derived, or NDA exam content.

officialPublicEvidence.note: The public guide says each item states how many responses to select.

reportedFormats: scenario matching with reusable drop-down options
practitionerReportedFormatEvidence.additionalReportedFormat: yes/no matrix with one scenario and independently judged statements

userSuppliedReferenceReview.description: Independent CCAR-P full practice set supplied for structural comparison; not committed to the repository.
userSuppliedReferenceReview.declaredByAuthor: Original practice content, not live exam content.

simulationPolicy.scoring: All-or-nothing per item for single-answer, multiple-response, matching, and matrix composites.
simulationPolicy.questionDesign: Enterprise judgment scenarios where a discriminating constraint determines the best architectural action and distractors remain plausible but off-target.
simulationPolicy.contentProvenance: Original practice content only. No live, recalled, screenshot-derived, dump, or NDA exam questions.
